messages:
sarah: Heads-up: NVD just published CVE-2026-1234 affecting ingress-nginx (header parsing RCE) and CVE-2026-2345 for kubelet (LPE when readOnlyPort enabled). Need quick triage and rollout plan. :rotating_light:
omar: ack, thanks. Can you paste the advisory links?
sarah: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-1234 and https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-2345
omar: quick read — ingress looks exploitable over internet-facing LB -> high. kubelet is local node LPE, depends on readOnlyPort exposure (we mostly disable it). My vote: ingress = P0, kubelet = P1 (investigate exposure). :eyes:
julia: cert-manager also has a CVE-ish bug in 1.10 around ACME challenge handling; upstream recommends 1.11. Not critical RCE but could break renewals. We should bundle cert-manager upgrade with ingress rollout to avoid cert flapping.
mike: audit logging note: when we patch control plane components, ensure audit logs capture the configmap/ingress-controller changes. I'm going to enable higher retention for 48h for affected clusters and add an audit rule for "update" on configmaps and deployments.
ashley: For Dedicated pools: suggest canary deploy to 10% nodes in us-west-2 first, then 25% EU, then global. Use node label selector and drain/upgrade per node. Add automatic rollback if 5xx > 1% for 5m.
liam: Mitigations before full rollout: 1) WAF rules to drop suspicious headers (limit header size/count). 2) Ensure nginx configmap has `underscores-in-headers` off and `large_client_header_buffers` tightened. 3) Ensure kubelet readOnlyPort is 0/disabled everywhere and firewall off-master -> node ports.
omar: sounds good. Can we apply header-based middleware at LB (fast) while builds for image patch roll out? That buys time.
sarah: yes — will ask infra to push LB rule. Also need KMS note: cert rotation may touch keys in KMS; julia, does cert-manager rotation trigger key rewrap or new key creation?
julia: cert-manager uses private keys in secrets; for Private deployments with customer-managed KMS we have envelope encryption. Upgrade won't rotate KMS keys automatically, but code path touching secrets may require re-encryption if we rotate keys later. We should: 1) ensure KMS IAM principals for the upgrade job exist, 2) snapshot secrets (encrypted) and verify decrypt post-upgrade.
mike: add to runbook: pre-upgrade: snapshot secrets (vault export + S3 encrypted snapshot), enable audit retention, create canary cluster. Post-upgrade: smoke test ACME, test signing, verify audit events.
sarah: owners: ingress-nginx patch = @omar, kubelet exposure audit = @liam, cert-manager upgrade + KMS validation = @julia, observability/audit = @mike. Can everyone confirm?
omar: confirmed. Starting image build and vulnerability scan now.
liam: confirmed. Will run a cluster-wide check for readOnlyPort and hostNetwork pods. Quick grep: ``kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\t"}{.status.addresses[*].address}{"\n"}{end}'`` — will post results.
deploy-bot: [pipeline] triggered: ingress-nginx-patch-image-build #487 by omar — https://ci.redwood/infrastructure/487 :white_check_mark:
sarah: timeline proposal: LB rule + WAF today (fast mitigation), image patch canary tomorrow (start 12:00 UTC), kubelet audit & mitigations in 48h, cert-manager upgrade in 7 days (with KMS smoke test). If exploit seen in wild -> expedite cert-manager.
ojulia: typo — meant "if exploit seen in wild -> expedite cert-manager" but mainly expedite ingress/kubelet.
mike: i'll prepare the runbook template in #incidents and link.
sarah: thanks. I'll open a Jira: RINF-1423 (ingress RCE emergency), RINF-1424 (kubelet exposure triage), RINF-1425 (cert-manager upgrade + KMS validation). Adding owners and due dates.
omar: will post canary logs and live tail: ``kubectl logs -n ingress-nginx -l app.kubernetes.io/name=ingress-nginx -f``
sarah: final: please react with :thumbsup: once you've double-checked the preflight checklist in the Jira. We'll reconvene here after first canary completes. :thumbsup:
